sources.document: Autoridad Nacional del Agua instalará estación hidrológica automatizada en el río Huaura
admissible_claims: ANA identified sector Alco, district of Sayán, as the location for an automatic hydrological station on Rio Huaura
ANA stated the station would provide real-time river discharge information and integrate with SNIRH
forbidden_inferences: station data are equivalent to tributary-ravine observations
the station defines an IRFEN threshold
the station location is an event footprint
the presence of a station resolves travel time or hydraulic capacity

sources.document: Presentan avance de la instalación de estación hidrológica automática en Huaura
admissible_claims: ANA located the automatic Rio Huaura station at Alco in Sayán
ANA described satellite transmission and real-time publication through SNIRH
ANA described use for water availability, drought prevention and evaluation of high-flow conditions
forbidden_inferences: provider monitoring objectives are IRFEN decision thresholds
the source supplies a validated event-paired hydrograph

sources.document: ANA entrega combustible a Junta de Usuarios del Sector Hidráulico de Huaura para trabajos de encauzamiento y descolmatación en el río Huaura
admissible_claims: ANA reported damage at Humaya and Vilcahuaura intakes and diversion canals due to a rise of Rio Huaura
ANA reported irrigation-water service interruption associated with the damaged infrastructure
the report supports a positive 2023 river-rise impact at the named infrastructure nodes
forbidden_inferences: the affected infrastructure defines the full event footprint
Humaya or Vilcahuaura are hydrologic basins
the report supplies historical hydraulic capacity
the corrective works define an IRFEN threshold
the event proves activation of unresolved local ravines

sources.document: Autoridad Nacional del Agua coordina delimitación de 7 kilómetros de zona de riesgo de inundación el río Huaura
admissible_claims: ANA coordinated delimitation of seven kilometers of Rio Huaura marginal strip in Sayán
ANA described the faja marginal as public hydraulic domain and regulatory protection context
forbidden_inferences: the faja marginal is a historical event footprint

sources.document: ANIN interviene en ríos Cañete y Huaura para reducir riesgos y asegurar continuidad de obras
